title: Telling Time Worksheets: Hours and Half Hours
intro: Teach hours and half hours using both clock hands.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Start at an exact hour, then move the minute hand halfway around. Show the hour hand moving halfway toward the next hour.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

3:00: the long hand points to 12 and the short hand points to 3.

3:30: the long hand points to 6 and the short hand is halfway from 3 to 4.

Ask your student

Where should the hour hand be at half past?

If your student needs help

If the student reads the next hour too soon, point to the hour the short hand has already passed.

Choosing and using the worksheet

Each set contains six distinct times at the hour or half hour. The original clock drawings show all twelve numbers and two hands. Sets do not guarantee an equal number of :00 and :30 examples.
